title: LoaderScopeKind
description: What a claim scope represents, for diagnostics only. Ownership never varies by kind: every scope holds and releases claims identically. `'app'` is the loader's own application-lifetime scope, `'scene'` a scene's automatic scope, `'scope'` one created explicitly via Loader.createScope or LoaderScope.createScope, `'container'` the entries an asset container unpacked, and `'dependency'` the sub-assets a single asset's own load pulled in.

sections.title: Import
paragraphs: What a claim scope represents, for diagnostics only. Ownership never varies by kind: every scope holds and releases claims identically.

`'app'` is the loader's own application-lifetime scope, `'scene'` a scene's automatic scope, `'scope'` one created explicitly via Loader.createScope or LoaderScope.createScope, `'container'` the entries an asset container unpacked, and `'dependency'` the sub-assets a single asset's own load pulled in.
